speed_task.fall: body +Z world projection <= 0, transformed CAD hull vertex clearance <= 0, or positive body floor normal force
speed_task.observations: privileged task diagnostics, not actor sensor inputs
speed_task.sampling: transition endpoints; hull vertices against runtime floor/height field, not continuous CAD collision certification

environment_contract.termination_sampling: action transition endpoints; not physical travel stops

neural_residual.command_saturation: Combined finite Rhai/neural requests are saturated at existing software/CAD command bounds before the same servo dynamics. Neural correction telemetry records the requested correction; policy targets record the applied command.
neural_residual.scope: Bounded corrections after Rhai feedback, before software/CAD command validation. Pure Rust inference from current sampled observations; no physics bypass.

task_observations.coordinate_frame: Body gravity direction, absolute COM velocity and angular velocity resolved in reference-link axes. Marker position and its time derivative relative to reference-link COM/axes. Floor force in world axes; link resultant excluding internal contacts, not force at marker.

policy_contract.timing: Sample committed state before the next physics interval; targets are held until subsequent firmware sampling. Rendering does not set either clock.

trajectory_forecast.scope: Causal separate horizon heads consume current Rust dynamics, backward finite-interval acceleration, previous applied commands and the current clamped Rhai proposal held for that horizon. No recorded future state or command is read. Forecast valid is zero until a previous sampled state exists; startup forecast values are placeholders. Forecasts describe the baseline proposal, before neural corrections; prediction error under learner commands requires separate validation.
